title: lore rename strips the '# yaml-language-server: $schema=' frontmatter line from the renamed file and every rewritten file (OPAG-438)
description: Reproduced by opum-agent (OPAG-438 note, 2026-09-25, lore 0.9.2) on a git archive of opum-ai/proof-skills at 51c8e28: 'lore rename adr/0006-distribute-through-the-opum-marketplace adr/0006-distribute-via-opum' exited 0 with '4 files changed'; the renamed ADR 0006, ADR 0005 and epics/formal-verification-skills each carried exactly 1 '# yaml-language-server: $schema=...' frontmatter line before and 0 after. The link in 0005 was correctly repointed. A rename rewrites link targets and frontmatter refs; it must preserve frontmatter comments. Check whether supersede and replace share the frontmatter round-trip.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A test reproduces the loss on a bundle whose files carry the schema comment (red before the fix) and proves rename preserves it in the renamed file and every rewritten file
Every other command that re-serialises frontmatter (supersede, replace, link, sync) is checked for the same loss, with the result recorded here
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0

plan: 1. Root cause: serializeConcept rebuilds the fence from js-yaml dump, which drops YAML comments; the modeline sits inside the fence (concept.ts, scaffold.ts), so every re-serialising write strips it.
2. Write a failing rename test on a bundle whose files carry the modeline (renamed file + inbound rewritten files), confirm red.

3. Fix at the ADR-0011 frontmatter boundary (src/core/concept.ts): capture the leading comment block inside the fence on parse and re-emit it on serialize, so every write path that spreads a parsed Concept keeps it.
4. Test supersede, link, sync (re-serialising) and replace (raw-text) for the same loss; add tests where they re-serialise.
5. Mutation check: revert the fix, confirm the new tests go red.
6. Gates: full bun test and bun run lore check exit 0; record per-command AC2 results as a note; commit, push, open PR against dev.

ROOT CAUSE: src/core/concept.ts serializeConcept rebuilt the fence as '---' + yaml.dump(frontmatter) + '---' + body. js-yaml never sees comments, so the editor modeline (which lore itself places as the first line INSIDE the fence: scaffold.ts, serializeConceptWithModeline) was dropped by every command that re-serialises a parsed Concept. concept.ts documented this as an accepted ADR-0011 limitation. FIX (same file, the ADR-0011 frontmatter boundary): splitFrontmatter captures the comment block opening the fence (comment and blank lines before the first key, outer blanks trimmed) as a new optional Concept.leadingComments. serializeConcept re-emits it after the opening fence and refuses (validation LoreError) a value that is not pure comment lines ending in a newline. serializeConceptWithModeline replaces an existing yaml-language-server line instead of duplicating it. Comments after the first key are still dropped, as ADR-0011 documents; a test pins that. Comment-free concepts keep their exact previous shape (the key is absent).

finalSummary: lore rename (and supersede, link/unlink, sync) no longer strips the '# yaml-language-server: $schema=' modeline. Root cause: serializeConcept in src/core/concept.ts re-emitted frontmatter via yaml.dump, which never sees comments, so every command that rewrites a parsed concept dropped the in-fence modeline. Fix, in that one shared function: parse captures the comment block opening the fence as Concept.leadingComments; serialize re-emits it after validating it is pure comment lines (a hand-built value cannot inject YAML); serializeConceptWithModeline replaces rather than duplicates an existing modeline. Comments after the first key remain dropped per ADR-0011, pinned by a test. AC2 per command: rename, supersede, link/unlink and sync all lost the modeline before (each now has a red-before/green-after test); replace edits raw text and never lost it (byte-exact test). Mutation: restoring dev's concept.ts turned exactly the 9 predicted of 12 new tests red. Verified: full bun test 0 (3485 pass), bun run lore check 0, and CI run 36262813905 on PR head de7fb086 green (12 success, 2 promotion guards skipped). Delivered in opum-ai/lore-cli#290. Follow-ups noted, not acted on: ADR-0006 and ADR-0011 say the modeline sits above the fence (code and bundle put it inside); rename still reflows flow-style lists.
